title: Brain Tumor: Types, Symptoms, Diagnosis & Treatment | World Brain Tumor Day (2020)
description: Watch ► Brain Tumor: Types, Symptoms, Diagnosis & Treatment |  World Brain Tumor Day 2020  On the occasion of World Brain Tumor Day, Dr. Shekhar Chirmade, Consultant- Neurosurgery & Spine at Ashoka Medicover Hospitals, Nashik spoke about Brain Tumor, Types of Brain tumor, Symptoms of brain tumor, How brain tumor is Diagnosed & Brain Tumor Treatment  Have questions related to the Brain tumor?  Call for Consultation: [PHONE] or visit us at http://www.medicoverhospitals.in  Video Transcript: Hello, I am Dr. Shekhar Chirmade, Neuro Spine Surgeon at Ashoka Medicover Hospitals, Nashik, India. This 8th of June is World Brain Tumor Day. I am going to talk on Information about Brain Tumor.  What is a Brain Tumor?  - 00:36 People are afraid of Brain Tumors. Brain Tumor is a very very rare condition that very few people usually affected by it. Of any aging brain, tumors can occur, It usually occurs in fifth or sixth decades of the patients i.e., after fifty years. But it also common in children.  Brain Tumor Types - 01:10  In the brain, you can get two types of tumors. They are  1) Benign Tumors: Benign tumor is completely removed from the brain, can be completely removed. Usually, do not have any problem in their future life.   2) Malignant Tumors: In the malignant tumor can spread, Similarly, in the brain, the malignant tumor can be removed or it can cause recurrence of the brain, but not spread outside of the brain. It recurs into the brain.  Symptoms of a Brain Tumor - 01:50  Usually, brain tumor symptoms person have very very less headache of less severity and they are of short duration, whereas if somebody is suffering from severe headache and if it is long term headache like six months, one year, two years. But if the headache is associated with vomiting and if it is associated with loss of consciousness, Imbalance or some visual difficulties, some visual problems all these symptoms then one can have the possibility of having a brain tumor.  Brain Tumor Diagnosis - 02:53  Diagnosis of Brain Tumor can be done by either doing the CT scan of the brain or MRI of the Brain. MRI usually cannot miss any brain tumor, CT scan sometimes misses brain tumors  Brain Tumor Treatment - 03:18  Majority of the Brain tumors require Surgery. Some of the brain tumors can be managed by tablets and medicines But the majority of the tumors require surgery.  #BrainTumor #MedicoverHospitals  Follow us on Other Platforms:  Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MedicoverHospitals/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/medicoverhospitals/ Twitter: https://twitter.com/medicoverin Linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/company/medicoverhospitals

asr.full_text: Hello everyone I am Dr. Shekhar Cheermade NeuroSpine Surgeon at Ashoka Medicover hospital,Nasi. Today is 8th of June,that is International Brain Turema Day I am going to talk on information about brain tumour. What is brain tumour? People are afraid of brain tumour and they gets fright when they hear of brain tumour. Brain tumour is the very very rare condition and very peope usually affected it. Any age of the brain tumour can occur. It usually occurs in the 5th or 6th decade of the patient. That is after 50th years, but it is common in the young people and children. As you must have heard, there are two types of tumor in body, some are benign and malignant and some are be malignant So, in the brain you will get two types of tumor. There are benign tumor and malignant tumor Benign tumors when a tumor is completely removed from brain. The tumor can be completely cured of the illness and usually patients do not have any problems in their future life. But in the Malignant Tumor, as we must have heard in the body, the Malignant Tumor can recur, it can spread. Similarly in the brain, even if the Malignant Tumor is removed, it can cause a recurrence in the brain. But usually they do not spread into outside the brain, into the body. They usually recur in the brain but usually it does not spread out into the brain into the body. Now you can ask me what are the symptoms of the brain tumours otherwise you must have heard people gets frightened because more severe headache but usually brain tumour usually the brain tumor patients gets very, very less headaches. Headaches are of less severity and they are of the short duration whereas if somebody is suffering from severe headache and if it is a long-term headache like six months, one year, or two years usually these patients do not have headache. But if the headache is associated with early morning vomiting One limb like upper limb or lower limb and sometimes switch and if the headache is associated with all these symptoms then one can have a possibility of Brain Tumor and the diagnosis can be done by either by doing a CT scan of the brain or MRI of the brain MRI usually cannot miss any brain tumour a CT scan sometimes it can miss early tumors but usually the MRI with the contrast, if it is done, the diagnosis of the majority of the brain tumors can be done. Once the diagnosis is done then becomes what are the treatment options. So as the tumors of the body require surgery, majority of the brain tumors require surgery. Some of the brain tumors can be managed with the tablet and medicines but majority of the tumors needs to be operated and if it is the benign tumors, the aim of the surgery should be the total removal of the tumor so that patients can be cured of it. And if it is a malignant tumor, the aim is near a total removal but at the preservation of the tumor- preservation of the patients and prevention of the future neurological deficit. For more information on the DHEED website, call 966-2787 or visit us at www.dheed.in
